blocks.text: Passport renewal
Fees and payment
Department of Immigration
Apply for a passport online and collect it from the nearest office.
Pay Nu. 500 by 30 June 2026.
The fee for a new citizenship certificate is Nu. 1,500.
Applications received after 1st July 2026 will be processed within 10 working days.
Quote your file reference DEMO-HR/2025/0457 in all correspondence.
Your CID number 00012345678 must match the name on your application.
Late applications attract a surcharge of 12.5% on the standard fee.
Read the ⟦1⟧eligibility rules⟦/1⟧ before you apply.
Download ⟦1⟧Form Five⟦/1⟧ and submit it to the ⟦2⟧Department of Immigration⟦/2⟧.

Applications are ⟦1⟧not⟦/1⟧ accepted by email.
You must bring ⟦1⟧two⟦/1⟧ passport photographs and your ⟦2⟧original⟦/2⟧ certificate.
